slide_1.first_textbox: This intentionally compresses many action points into one slide.
slide_1.first_bullet: Define owners for every dependency; Track SLA breaches weekly; Publish risk snapshots for leadership; Include unresolved blockers with due dates
slide_1.second_bullet: Document rollback paths for every release train; Verify observability coverage across core services; Add escalation contacts for weekends and holidays
slide_1.third_bullet: Capture postmortem learnings with corrective actions; Review change windows before peak events; Align communication templates across support channels
slide_1.second_textbox: The layout should degrade gracefully rather than collide or overlap.
